summary: Idiofa territory part 1 (Kwilu) covers Idiofa town and the Idiofa and Ipamu secteurs, including the Kasai river towns of Mangai and Dibaya-Lubwe. No armed group is reported to control or regularly raid any locality here; the Mobondo militia theatre lies far to the west (Kwamouth, Bagata, Kwango) and the former Kamuina Nsapu areas of the Kasai provinces are across the Kasai/Loange to the east. All locations are assessed as under ordinary state authority with the PNC as the main permanent force and customary chiefs under it. Live web research was unavailable for this run, so confidence is medium for the main towns and low elsewhere.

zones.description: Idiofa town, territorial seat (Idiofa health zone, Kizito health areas)
zones.evidence: Territorial seat with territorial administration, PNC commissariat, courts and prison; no armed group reported controlling or regularly raiding the town. No source reports armed-group activity in this area as of the reference date; the Mobondo militia theatre (Kwamouth, Bagata, Kenge, Kwango) lies far to the west. Live web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, news sites blocked), so the assessment rests on default state presence.
